dataset: Rumor Crusher — 100 medical claims with top-journal evidence verdicts

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: vaccinated working adults had 25% fewer upper respiratory illness episodes than placebo recipients
citations.title: The effectiveness of vaccination against influenza in healthy, working adults

citations.key_finding: pooled analysis found inactivated influenza vaccine 59% efficacious in adults aged 18-65
citations.title: Efficacy and effectiveness of influenza vaccines: a systematic review and meta-analysis

citations.key_finding: inactivated vaccine reduced influenza from 2.3% to 0.9% in healthy adults
citations.title: Vaccines for preventing influenza in healthy adults

claims.claim_en: Getting a flu shot can actually give you the flu
claims.claim_zh: 打流感疫苗反而会让人得流感
claims.why_zh: 流感疫苗里装的是已经灭活或弱化的病毒，没法让你得流感，而且打了疫苗的人感冒和流感样发作反而更少。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 537,303 Danish children showed no increased risk of autism after MMR vaccination (adjusted RR 0.92)
citations.title: A population-based study of measles, mumps, and rubella vaccination and autism

citations.key_finding: 657,461 children showed no increased risk of autism after MMR vaccination (aHR 0.93)
citations.title: Measles, Mumps, Rubella Vaccination and Autism: A Nationwide Cohort Study

citations.key_finding: Cochrane review of 138 studies found no association between MMR vaccine and autism
citations.title: Vaccines for measles, mumps, rubella, and varicella in children

claims.claim_en: The MMR vaccine causes autism in children
claims.claim_zh: 打麻腮风（MMR）疫苗会导致孩子得自闭症
claims.why_zh: 丹麦几十万孩子的大调查发现，打没打MMR疫苗的孩子得自闭症的比例几乎一样，疫苗和自闭症没有关系。

citations.key_finding: 467,450 children showed no dose-response link between thimerosal-containing vaccine and autism (RR 0.85)
citations.title: Association between thimerosal-containing vaccine and autism

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 1,047 children showed no causal association between early thimerosal exposure and 42 neuropsychological outcomes
citations.title: Early thimerosal exposure and neuropsychological outcomes at 7 to 10 years

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: reviewed the evidence and concluded it does not support thimerosal in vaccines causing harm
citations.title: Thimerosal and Vaccines — A Cautionary Tale

claims.claim_en: The mercury preservative thimerosal in vaccines causes autism
claims.claim_zh: 疫苗里含水银（硫柳汞），会把孩子毒成自闭症
claims.why_zh: 几十万孩子的数据显示，接触硫柳汞多少和自闭症没有关系，后来疫苗里去掉它，自闭症人数也没有下降。

citations.key_finding: 45 men showed no decrease in any sperm parameter after mRNA vaccination
citations.title: Sperm Parameters Before and After COVID-19 mRNA Vaccination

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 35,691 pregnant v-safe participants showed no obvious safety signals from mRNA vaccines
citations.title: Preliminary Findings of mRNA Covid-19 Vaccine Safety in Pregnant Persons

citations.key_finding: 105,446 pregnancies showed no increased risk of spontaneous abortion after COVID-19 vaccination (adjusted OR 1.02)
citations.title: Spontaneous Abortion Following COVID-19 Vaccination During Pregnancy

claims.claim_en: COVID-19 vaccines cause infertility in men and women
claims.claim_zh: 打新冠疫苗会导致不孕不育
claims.why_zh: 科学家测过打疫苗前后的精子数量和几万名孕妇的怀孕结果，都没有变差，疫苗不会影响生孩子。

citations.key_finding: nearly 4 million females in Denmark and Sweden showed no increased risk of multiple sclerosis after HPV vaccination (adjusted RR 0.90)
citations.title: Quadrivalent HPV vaccination and risk of multiple sclerosis and other demyelinating diseases of the central nervous system

citations.key_finding: about 1 million girls showed no evidence of association between HPV vaccine and 53 autoimmune, neurological, and thromboembolic outcomes
citations.title: Autoimmune, neurological, and venous thromboembolic adverse events after immunisation of adolescent girls with quadrivalent human papillomavirus vaccine in Denmark and Sweden: cohort study

citations.key_finding: 26 trials with 73,428 participants found high-certainty protection against cervical precancer and no increase in serious adverse events
citations.title: Prophylactic vaccination against human papillomaviruses to prevent cervical cancer and its precursors

claims.claim_en: The HPV vaccine triggers autoimmune diseases
claims.claim_zh: 打HPV疫苗会引发自身免疫病
claims.why_zh: 北欧上百万女孩的长期跟踪发现，打过HPV疫苗的人得自身免疫病的比例和没打的人完全一样。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: Nurses' Health Studies nested case-control analysis found no association between hepatitis B vaccination and multiple sclerosis (RR 0.9)
citations.title: Hepatitis B vaccination and the risk of multiple sclerosis

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 643 patients showed vaccination, including hepatitis B, did not increase the risk of multiple sclerosis relapse (RR 0.71)
citations.title: Vaccinations and the risk of relapse in multiple sclerosis

citations.key_finding: 780 cases and 3,885 controls showed no longer-term association between hepatitis B vaccine and multiple sclerosis
citations.title: Vaccines and the risk of multiple sclerosis and other central nervous system demyelinating diseases

claims.claim_en: The hepatitis B vaccine causes multiple sclerosis
claims.claim_zh: 打乙肝疫苗会导致多发性硬化
claims.why_zh: 这个说法最早是传闻，但护士群体和病人对照研究都发现，打乙肝疫苗的人得硬化症的比例并不比别人高。

citations.key_finding: previous infection was associated with an 84% lower risk of reinfection, with protection observed for at least 7 months
citations.title: SARS-CoV-2 infection rates of antibody-positive compared with antibody-negative health-care workers in England: a large, multicentre, prospective cohort study (SIREN)

citations.key_finding: vaccination after natural infection cut reinfection risk further (one-dose hybrid immunity aHR 0.42, two-dose 0.34)
citations.title: Risk of SARS-CoV-2 reinfection and COVID-19 hospitalisation in individuals with natural and hybrid immunity: a retrospective, total population cohort study in Sweden

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: both natural and hybrid immunity waned over time, though hybrid immunity remained stronger
citations.title: Protection and Waning of Natural and Hybrid Immunity to SARS-CoV-2

claims.claim_en: If you have already had COVID-19, you never need the vaccine
claims.claim_zh: 得过新冠就有抗体了，不用再打疫苗
claims.why_zh: 得过新冠确实能保护你一阵子，但这份保护会慢慢变弱，再补一针疫苗组成的混合免疫更强也更持久。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in people 60 and older, a booster made confirmed infection 11.3 times lower and severe illness 19.5 times lower
citations.title: Protection of BNT162b2 Vaccine Booster against Covid-19 in Israel

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: two BNT162b2 doses fell from 65.5% effectiveness against Omicron at 2-4 weeks to 8.8% at 25 weeks or more
citations.title: Covid-19 Vaccine Effectiveness against the Omicron (B.1.1.529) Variant

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: effectiveness against infection peaked at 77.5% in the first month and fell to about 20% by months 5-7, while protection against severe disease stayed above 90%
citations.title: Waning of BNT162b2 Vaccine Protection against SARS-CoV-2 Infection in Qatar

claims.claim_en: Protection from COVID-19 vaccines fades after a few months, so booster shots are needed
claims.claim_zh: 新冠疫苗打完过几个月保护就变弱了，得打加强针
claims.why_zh: 数据摆在那儿：两针打完半年后防感染的效果从六成多掉到一成左右，而打一针加强针又能把保护拉回来。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: maternal influenza immunization reduced laboratory-confirmed influenza in infants by 63%
citations.title: Effectiveness of maternal influenza immunization in mothers and infants

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: randomized trials showed vaccine efficacy of about 50.4% in pregnant women and 48.8% in their infants
citations.title: Influenza Vaccination of Pregnant Women and Protection of Their Infants

citations.key_finding: pooled analysis of 10,002 women showed infant efficacy of 35% up to 6 months and 56% in the first 2 months of life
citations.title: Efficacy, duration of protection, birth outcomes, and infant growth associated with influenza vaccination in pregnancy: a pooled analysis of three randomised controlled trials

claims.claim_en: Getting a flu shot during pregnancy also protects the baby after birth
claims.claim_zh: 孕妇打流感疫苗，出生后的宝宝也能少得流感
claims.why_zh: 妈妈打疫苗做出的抗体能通过胎盘送给宝宝，宝宝出生头几个月还不能打疫苗，就靠这份抗体挡流感。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: the adjuvanted subunit vaccine was 97.2% efficacious against herpes zoster in adults 50 years and older (ZOE-50)
citations.title: Efficacy of an Adjuvanted Herpes Zoster Subunit Vaccine in Older Adults

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: efficacy was 91.3% against herpes zoster and 88.8% against postherpetic neuralgia in adults 70 and older (ZOE-70)
citations.title: Efficacy of the Herpes Zoster Subunit Vaccine in Adults 70 Years of Age or Older

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in 38,546 adults, vaccination reduced the incidence of postherpetic neuralgia by 66.5% and of herpes zoster by 51.3%
citations.title: A Vaccine to Prevent Herpes Zoster and Postherpetic Neuralgia in Older Adults

claims.claim_en: The shingles vaccine really can prevent postherpetic neuralgia, the long-lasting nerve pain after shingles
claims.claim_zh: 带状疱疹疫苗真能预防带状疱疹后神经痛
claims.why_zh: 几万人的临床试验证明，新款带状疱疹疫苗防发病超过九成，连最折磨人的后遗神经痛也能防住八九成。

citations.key_finding: antibiotics showed no benefit over placebo for the common cold and increased adverse effects
citations.title: Antibiotics for the common cold and acute purulent rhinitis

citations.key_finding: across 29 trials, 82% of placebo patients were symptom-free by one week, so most sore throats resolve without antibiotics
citations.title: Antibiotics for treatment of sore throat in children and adults

citations.key_finding: 17 trials showed only limited benefit from antibiotics in acute bronchitis and more adverse effects (RR 1.20)
citations.title: Antibiotics for acute bronchitis

claims.claim_en: Taking antibiotics helps you recover from a common cold faster
claims.claim_zh: 感冒了吃抗生素好得快
claims.why_zh: 感冒是病毒惹的祸，抗生素只杀细菌不杀病毒，吃了不但好不了，还会多出拉肚子之类的副作用。

citations.key_finding: seasonal influenza is associated with an estimated 291,243 to 645,832 respiratory deaths worldwide each year
citations.title: Estimates of global seasonal influenza-associated respiratory mortality: a modelling study

citations.key_finding: influenza was associated with an average of about 36,155 respiratory and circulatory deaths per year in the United States
citations.title: Mortality associated with influenza and respiratory syncytial virus in the United States

citations.key_finding: Lancet seminar describes influenza as a systemic viral disease distinct from the common cold that can cause pneumonia and death
citations.title: Influenza

claims.claim_en: Influenza is just a heavy cold and nothing to worry about
claims.claim_zh: 流感就是重点的感冒，没什么大不了
claims.why_zh: 普通感冒最多难受几天，而流感每年在全世界带走几十万条命，还能引起肺炎，根本不是一个级别的病。

citations.key_finding: in 342,183 adults, mask promotion reduced symptomatic seroprevalence (aPR 0.91), with a stronger effect in surgical-mask villages among people 60 and older (aPR 0.65)
citations.title: Impact of community masking on COVID-19: A cluster-randomized trial in Bangladesh

citations.key_finding: surgical masks significantly reduced influenza virus RNA in respiratory droplets and coronavirus RNA in aerosols
citations.title: Respiratory virus shedding in exhaled breath and efficacy of face masks

citations.key_finding: surgical masks were noninferior to N95 respirators for preventing laboratory-confirmed influenza among 446 nurses
citations.title: Surgical mask vs N95 respirator for preventing influenza among health care workers: a randomized trial

claims.claim_en: Mask pores are far bigger than viruses, so wearing a mask cannot block viruses at all
claims.claim_zh: 口罩的孔比病毒大得多，戴口罩根本挡不住病毒
claims.why_zh: 病毒出门大多坐在飞沫这辆车上，口罩拦的是车不是单个病毒，34万人的大实验证明推广戴口罩的村子感染的人明显更少。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 56% of positive residents were asymptomatic at testing, and viable virus was recovered from presymptomatic residents
citations.title: Presymptomatic SARS-CoV-2 Infections and Transmission in a Skilled Nursing Facility

citations.key_finding: an estimated 44% of secondary cases were infected during the index case's presymptomatic stage
citations.title: Temporal dynamics in viral shedding and transmissibility of COVID-19

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: asymptomatic and presymptomatic transmission undermines symptom-based screening as a control strategy
citations.title: Asymptomatic Transmission, the Achilles' Heel of Current Strategies to Control Covid-19

claims.claim_en: People without any symptoms cannot spread COVID-19
claims.claim_zh: 没有症状的人不会传染新冠，不用防着他们
claims.why_zh: 很多人在还没出现症状的时候喉咙里就有活病毒能传给别人，据估计四成多的新冠传染发生在病人发病之前。

citations.key_finding: protection against reinfection was 80.5% overall but only 47.1% in people aged 65 and older
citations.title: Assessment of protection against reinfection with SARS-CoV-2 among 4 million PCR-tested individuals in Denmark in 2020: a population-level observational study

citations.key_finding: reinfection carried higher risks of death (HR 2.17) and hospitalization (HR 3.32) than no reinfection
citations.title: Acute and postacute sequelae associated with SARS-CoV-2 reinfection

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: previous infection alone was only 46.1% effective against symptomatic Omicron BA.2 infection, while hybrid immunity was strongest
citations.title: Effects of Previous Infection and Vaccination on Symptomatic Omicron Infections

claims.claim_en: Once you have had COVID-19, you are immune for life and cannot be reinfected
claims.claim_zh: 得过一次新冠就终身免疫，不会再感染了
claims.why_zh: 得过新冠的保护力大概只有八成，65岁以上的人还不到一半，而且第二次感染比第一次更容易住院甚至出事。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: viable virus was detectable for up to 72 hours on plastic and steel under laboratory conditions, though titers fell sharply
citations.title: Aerosol and Surface Stability of SARS-CoV-2 as Compared with SARS-CoV-1

citations.key_finding: the chance of fomite transmission in real life is very small because surface studies used unrealistically high viral loads
citations.title: Exaggerated risk of transmission of COVID-19 by fomites

citations.key_finding: environmental sampling under real-life hospital conditions found a low risk of transmission by fomites
citations.title: Low risk of SARS-CoV-2 transmission by fomites in real-life conditions

claims.claim_en: Touching parcels and doorknobs is the main way people catch COVID-19
claims.claim_zh: 摸快递、碰门把手是感染新冠的主要方式
claims.why_zh: 实验室里病毒确实能在塑料上活到三天，但真实生活中靠摸东西传染的概率很小，新冠主要是顺着空气里的飞沫传播的。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in 700 ICU patients, acetaminophen lowered fever but did not change ICU-free days or mortality (HEAT trial)
citations.title: Acetaminophen for Fever in Critically Ill Patients with Suspected Infection

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: ibuprofen reduced fever in 455 sepsis patients but did not improve survival (37% vs 40% mortality)
citations.title: The effects of ibuprofen on the physiology and survival of patients with sepsis

citations.key_finding: BMJ clinical review: febrile seizures in children are benign and have a normal cognitive outcome
citations.title: Febrile seizures

claims.claim_en: A child's fever will burn and damage their brain if it is not brought down quickly
claims.claim_zh: 孩子发烧不赶紧退烧会把脑子烧坏
claims.why_zh: 发烧是身体打仗的正常反应、体温不会无限升高，试验证明硬把烧退下去也不会让人好得更快，真正伤脑子的是脑炎这类病本身不是发烧。

citations.key_finding: in 77 unvaccinated children, measles eliminated 11% to 73% of the preexisting antibody repertoire
citations.title: Measles virus infection diminishes preexisting antibodies that offer protection from other pathogens

citations.key_finding: measles-induced immunomodulation lasts about 2-3 years and tracks with deaths from non-measles infections
citations.title: Long-term measles-induced immunomodulation increases overall childhood infectious disease mortality

citations.key_finding: Lancet seminar documents measles virus-induced immune suppression and immune amnesia as a major cause of measles complications
citations.title: Measles

claims.claim_en: Measles erases the immune system's memory of other germs, so children get infections more easily for years afterwards
claims.claim_zh: 得过一次麻疹，身体会把以前记住的病菌记忆抹掉，之后几年更容易生病
claims.why_zh: 科学家直接查了孩子的血液，发现得过麻疹后身体把以前攒下的抗体丢掉了11%到73%，这叫免疫遗忘。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 153 influenza-associated deaths were reported among US children in a single season, with a median age of 3 years
citations.title: Influenza-associated deaths among children in the United States, 2003-2004

citations.key_finding: of an estimated 284,500 deaths from 2009 pandemic H1N1, 80% were in people younger than 65 years
citations.title: Estimated global mortality associated with the first 12 months of 2009 pandemic influenza A H1N1 virus circulation: a modelling study

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 722 patients were admitted to ICUs with confirmed 2009 H1N1 in Australia and New Zealand, and 14.3% of them died
citations.title: Critical care services and 2009 H1N1 influenza in Australia and New Zealand

claims.claim_en: Influenza is only dangerous for old people; healthy young people have nothing to worry about
claims.claim_zh: 流感只有老年人才危险，健康年轻人不用担心
claims.why_zh: 2009年那场大流感里八成的死亡者不到65岁，光美国一个流感季就有一百多个孩子病死，年轻人照样会住进重症监护室。

citations.key_finding: across 78 randomized trials, hand hygiene interventions likely reduced respiratory illnesses
citations.title: Physical interventions to interrupt or reduce the spread of respiratory viruses

citations.key_finding: facemasks plus hand hygiene started within 36 hours of symptom onset reduced household influenza transmission (adjusted OR 0.33)
citations.title: Facemasks and hand hygiene to prevent influenza transmission in households: a cluster randomized trial

citations.key_finding: in 20,066 adults, a handwashing programme reduced respiratory infections (51% vs 59% reporting an infection; risk ratio 0.86)
citations.title: An internet-delivered handwashing intervention to modify influenza-like illness and respiratory infection transmission (PRIMIT): a primary care randomised trial

claims.claim_en: Washing your hands frequently really does reduce colds and other respiratory infections
claims.claim_zh: 勤洗手真的能减少感冒等呼吸道感染
claims.why_zh: 两万多人的大实验证明，认真洗手的人呼吸道感染少了大约14%，因为手是病毒搭便车钻进鼻子和嘴巴的主要通道。

citations.key_finding: smoking was linked to rising death rates from many diseases, not just lung cancer
citations.title: 50-year trends in smoking-related mortality in the United States

citations.key_finding: smokers had about three times the death rate of never-smokers across many causes
citations.title: 21st-century hazards of smoking and benefits of cessation in the United States

citations.key_finding: about 17% of excess deaths in smokers came from diseases not yet officially counted as smoking-caused, including breast and prostate cancer deaths
citations.title: Smoking and mortality--beyond established causes

claims.claim_en: Smoking only causes lung cancer and has little to do with other cancers.
claims.claim_zh: 吸烟只会得肺癌，对其他癌症没什么影响。
claims.why_zh: 烟雾里的毒素会流遍全身，除了肺癌，它还会增加十几种癌症的风险，比如乳腺癌和前列腺癌。

citations.key_finding: the level of alcohol consumption that minimized harm across health outcomes was zero standard drinks per week
citations.title: Alcohol use and burden for 195 countries and territories, 1990-2016: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2016

citations.key_finding: all-cause mortality risk rose steadily above about 100 g of alcohol per week, with no safe protective effect
citations.title: Risk thresholds for alcohol consumption: combined analysis of individual-participant data for 599 912 current drinkers in 83 prospective studies

citations.key_finding: an estimated 741,300 new cancer cases worldwide in 2020 were attributable to alcohol consumption
citations.title: Global burden of cancer in 2020 attributable to alcohol consumption: a population-based study

claims.claim_en: Drinking a little red wine every day is good for your health and helps prevent cancer.
claims.claim_zh: 每天喝一点红酒有益健康，还能防癌。
claims.why_zh: 酒精本身就是致癌物，哪怕每天只喝一点也会慢慢增加癌症风险，喝得越少越安全。

citations.authors: The Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta Carotene Cancer Prevention Study Group
citations.key_finding: beta carotene supplements increased lung cancer incidence by 18% in male smokers instead of preventing it
citations.title: The effect of vitamin E and beta carotene on the incidence of lung cancer and other cancers in male smokers

citations.key_finding: vitamin E supplements significantly increased prostate cancer risk (hazard ratio 1.17) in healthy men
citations.title: Vitamin E and the risk of prostate cancer: the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial (SELECT)

citations.key_finding: a daily multivitamin gave only a modest 8% reduction in total cancer and no reduction in any specific cancer
citations.title: Multivitamins in the prevention of cancer in men: the Physicians' Health Study II randomized controlled trial

claims.claim_en: Taking vitamin supplements can prevent cancer.
claims.claim_zh: 多吃维生素补充剂就能预防癌症。
claims.why_zh: 大型实验反复证明，维生素补充剂没有防癌效果，有的反而让某些癌症更容易发生。

citations.key_finding: the IARC working group found sufficient evidence that excess body fatness causes 13 types of cancer
citations.title: Body Fatness and Cancer -- Viewpoint of the IARC Working Group

citations.key_finding: higher body-mass index was associated with increased risk of many common cancers in a meta-analysis of prospective studies
citations.title: Body-mass index and incidence of cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective observational studies

citations.key_finding: an umbrella review found strong evidence linking excess adiposity to 11 cancers
citations.title: Adiposity and cancer at major anatomical sites: umbrella review of the literature

claims.claim_en: Being overweight is harmless, and obesity has nothing to do with cancer.
claims.claim_zh: 胖一点没关系，肥胖跟癌症没什么关系。
claims.why_zh: 国际癌症专家已经确认，身上的脂肪太多会让至少13种癌症更容易找上门。

citations.key_finding: cumulative CT doses around 50 mGy in childhood might almost triple leukaemia risk, but the absolute risks remained small
citations.title: Radiation exposure from CT scans in childhood and subsequent risk of leukaemia and brain tumours: a retrospective cohort study

citations.key_finding: cancer incidence was 24% higher in young people exposed to CT, an absolute excess of about 9.4 cases per 100,000 person-years
citations.title: Cancer risk in 680 000 people exposed to computed tomography scans in childhood or adolescence: data linkage study of 11 million Australians

citations.key_finding: an estimated 1.5-2% of future US cancers might be attributable to CT radiation, so scans should be justified and doses kept low, not avoided when needed
citations.title: Computed tomography--an increasing source of radiation exposure

claims.claim_en: Getting a single CT scan will give you cancer from the radiation, so you should never have one.
claims.claim_zh: 做一次CT检查，辐射就会让人得癌症，千万别做。
claims.why_zh: CT的辐射确实有一点点风险，尤其是对小朋友，但一次检查的额外风险非常小；该做时不做、耽误病情反而更危险。

citations.key_finding: girls vaccinated before age 17 had an 88% lower risk of invasive cervical cancer in a nationwide Swedish study
citations.title: HPV Vaccination and the Risk of Invasive Cervical Cancer

citations.key_finding: the quadrivalent HPV vaccine was 98% effective against high-grade cervical lesions in the per-protocol population
citations.title: Quadrivalent vaccine against human papillomavirus to prevent high-grade cervical lesions

citations.key_finding: across 26 trials with 73,428 women, HPV vaccines protected against cervical precancer and serious adverse events occurred in about 7% of both vaccine and control groups
citations.title: Prophylactic vaccination against human papillomaviruses to prevent cervical cancer and its precursors

claims.claim_en: The HPV vaccine is useless and may even be harmful, so don't get it.
claims.claim_zh: HPV疫苗根本没用，打了还可能有害，别打。
claims.why_zh: 上百万人的数据证明，HPV疫苗能大幅减少宫颈癌，严重不良反应的发生率跟打安慰剂差不多。

citations.authors: National Lung Screening Trial Research Team
citations.key_finding: low-dose CT screening reduced lung-cancer mortality by 20.0% relative to chest X-ray in 53,454 high-risk people
citations.title: Reduced lung-cancer mortality with low-dose computed tomographic screening

citations.authors: Independent UK Panel on Breast Cancer Screening
citations.key_finding: a meta-analysis of 11 trials found breast screening reduced breast-cancer mortality (relative risk 0.80), while overdiagnosis also occurs
citations.title: The benefits and harms of breast cancer screening: an independent review

citations.key_finding: PSA screening reduced the rate of death from prostate cancer by 20% in 162,243 men, at the cost of a high risk of overdiagnosis
citations.title: Screening and prostate-cancer mortality in a randomized European study

claims.claim_en: Cancer screening is just a money-making scam by hospitals; early screening doesn't help at all.
claims.claim_zh: 癌症筛查都是医院骗钱的，早期筛查根本没用。
claims.why_zh: 对高风险人群，筛查真的能救命，比如肺癌筛查让死亡风险下降了五分之一；它的问题是过度诊断，所以要挑对人、挑对项目，而不是全盘否定。

citations.key_finding: drinking very hot tea was associated with 8.16 times the odds of oesophageal cancer compared with warm or lukewarm tea
citations.title: Tea drinking habits and oesophageal cancer in a high risk area in northern Iran: population based case-control study

citations.key_finding: in 456,155 Chinese adults, burning-hot tea combined with daily alcohol use carried a hazard ratio of 5.00 for esophageal cancer, and with smoking 2.03
citations.title: Hot Tea Consumption and Its Interactions With Alcohol and Tobacco Use on the Risk for Esophageal Cancer: A Population-Based Cohort Study

citations.key_finding: IARC classified drinking very hot beverages above 65°C as probably carcinogenic to humans (Group 2A)
citations.title: Carcinogenicity of drinking coffee, mate, and very hot beverages

claims.claim_en: Regularly drinking very hot tea and eating very hot food increases the risk of esophageal cancer.
claims.claim_zh: 经常喝烫茶、吃烫的食物，会增加得食管癌的风险。
claims.why_zh: 太烫的饮料会一次次烫伤食道，好几个大研究都发现，喝滚烫茶水的人得食管癌的明显更多。

citations.key_finding: childhood liver cancer incidence in Taiwan fell from 0.70 to 0.36 per 100,000 after universal hepatitis B vaccination began in 1984
citations.title: Universal hepatitis B vaccination in Taiwan and the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma in children

citations.key_finding: liver cancer incidence rose from 108 to 1,152 per 100,000 person-years as hepatitis B viral load increased, showing the virus drives the cancer
citations.title: Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma across a biological gradient of serum hepatitis B virus DNA level

citations.key_finding: suppressing hepatitis B with antiviral treatment cut liver cancer occurrence from 7.4% to 3.9% (hazard ratio 0.49)
citations.title: Lamivudine for patients with chronic hepatitis B and advanced liver disease

claims.claim_en: Vaccinating children against hepatitis B can prevent liver cancer later in life.
claims.claim_zh: 给孩子接种乙肝疫苗，以后能预防肝癌。
claims.why_zh: 很多肝癌是乙肝病毒多年慢慢引起的，台湾全面给孩子打乙肝疫苗后，儿童肝癌的发生率明显下降了。

citations.key_finding: IARC classified processed meat as carcinogenic to humans (Group 1); each 50 g eaten daily raises colorectal cancer risk by about 18%
citations.title: Carcinogenicity of consumption of red and processed meat

citations.key_finding: each daily serving of processed red meat was associated with higher cancer mortality (hazard ratio 1.16) and total mortality (1.20)
citations.title: Red meat consumption and mortality: results from 2 prospective cohort studies

citations.key_finding: in over half a million people, the highest processed-meat intake was associated with elevated total and cancer mortality
citations.title: Meat intake and mortality: a prospective study of over half a million people

claims.claim_en: Eating processed meats like ham, sausages and bacon regularly increases the risk of colorectal cancer.
claims.claim_zh: 经常吃火腿、香肠、培根这些加工肉，会增加得肠癌的风险。
claims.why_zh: 国际癌症研究机构把加工肉列为明确的致癌物，每天吃50克，大肠癌风险大约增加18%。

citations.key_finding: in the COURAGE trial of 2,287 patients with stable disease, adding PCI to optimal medical therapy did not reduce death or heart attack
citations.title: Optimal medical therapy with or without PCI for stable coronary disease

citations.key_finding: in the ISCHEMIA trial of 5,179 patients, an initial invasive strategy did not reduce ischemic events or death versus a conservative strategy over a median 3.2 years
citations.title: Initial Invasive or Conservative Strategy for Stable Coronary Disease

citations.key_finding: in placebo-controlled ORBITA, PCI did not increase exercise time more than a sham procedure in stable single-vessel angina
citations.title: Percutaneous coronary intervention in stable angina (ORBITA): a double-blind, randomised controlled trial

claims.claim_en: Heart stents are a scam that other countries abandoned long ago; getting one is a waste of money.
claims.claim_zh: 心脏支架是骗人的，国外早就淘汰了，装支架纯粹是浪费钱。
claims.why_zh: 心梗突发时支架能救命、国外一直在用；只是病情稳定时，它主要是缓解胸痛，不一定比吃药更能延长寿命。

citations.key_finding: targeting systolic pressure below 120 rather than below 140 mm Hg cut the primary outcome (hazard ratio 0.75) and all-cause mortality (0.73)
citations.title: A Randomized Trial of Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control

citations.key_finding: each 20 mm Hg higher usual systolic pressure was associated with about a twofold higher risk of stroke and ischemic heart disease death, with no threshold down to 115/75
citations.title: Age-specific relevance of usual blood pressure to vascular mortality: a meta-analysis of individual data for one million adults in 61 prospective studies

citations.key_finding: across 123 trials with 613,815 participants, every 10 mm Hg reduction in systolic pressure cut major cardiovascular events (relative risk 0.80) and stroke (0.73)
citations.title: Blood pressure lowering for prevention of cardiovascular disease and death: a systematic review and meta-analysis

claims.claim_en: If high blood pressure causes no symptoms like dizziness, you don't need to take medication for it.
claims.claim_zh: 高血压只要没头晕、没症状，就不用吃药。
claims.why_zh: 高血压伤害血管是悄悄进行的，等有症状往往已经伤到心和脑了；把血压降下来能明显减少中风和死亡。

citations.key_finding: each 1.0 mmol/L LDL reduction cut major vascular events (relative risk 0.78) and all-cause mortality (0.90), with no effect on cancer incidence or non-vascular death
citations.title: Efficacy and safety of more intensive lowering of LDL cholesterol: a meta-analysis of data from 170,000 participants in 26 randomised trials

citations.key_finding: statins cut major vascular events by about 21% per 1 mmol/L LDL reduction even in low-risk people, with no increase in cancer incidence or mortality
citations.title: The effects of lowering LDL cholesterol with statin therapy in people at low risk of vascular disease: meta-analysis of individual data from 27 randomised trials

citations.key_finding: the only well-proven serious harms of statins are rare myopathy, new-onset diabetes and probably haemorrhagic stroke, and benefits greatly exceed harms
citations.title: Interpretation of the evidence for the efficacy and safety of statin therapy

claims.claim_en: Statins damage the liver and kidneys and must never be taken long-term.
claims.claim_zh: 他汀类药物伤肝又伤肾，绝对不能长期吃。
claims.why_zh: 几十万人参加的试验数据表明，他汀的严重副作用非常少见，它减少的心梗和中风远远多于它带来的伤害。

citations.key_finding: in 19,114 healthy elderly people (ASPREE), daily aspirin did not prolong disability-free survival (hazard ratio 1.01) and increased major hemorrhage (3.8% vs 2.8%)
citations.title: Effect of Aspirin on Disability-free Survival in the Healthy Elderly

citations.key_finding: in 15,480 people with diabetes, aspirin cut serious vascular events (8.5% vs 9.6%) but raised major bleeding (4.1% vs 3.2%), largely counterbalancing the benefit
citations.title: Effects of Aspirin for Primary Prevention in Persons with Diabetes Mellitus

citations.key_finding: in 12,546 moderate-risk patients, aspirin did not significantly reduce first vascular events (hazard ratio 0.96) and doubled gastrointestinal bleeding (2.11)
citations.title: Use of aspirin to reduce risk of initial vascular events in patients at moderate risk of cardiovascular disease (ARRIVE): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial

claims.claim_en: Aspirin is a miracle drug for preventing heart attacks, and every healthy person should take one daily.
claims.claim_zh: 阿司匹林是预防心梗的神药，健康人每天吃一片准没错。
claims.why_zh: 对已经得过心梗的人，阿司匹林确实重要；但健康人天天吃，防病的好处会被出血风险差不多抵消，不能自己乱吃。

citations.key_finding: across 23 trials with 7,739 STEMI patients, urgent hospital primary angioplasty beat thrombolysis on death (7% vs 9%) and on combined death, reinfarction and stroke (8% vs 14%)
citations.title: Primary angioplasty versus intravenous thrombolytic therapy for acute myocardial infarction: a quantitative review of 23 randomised trials

citations.key_finding: each 30-minute delay to primary angioplasty raised the relative risk of 1-year mortality by 7.5%
citations.title: Time delay to treatment and mortality in primary angioplasty for acute myocardial infarction: every minute of delay counts

citations.key_finding: in 6,209 STEMI patients, long-term mortality rose from 15.4% with system delay under 60 minutes to 30.8% with 181-360 minutes
citations.title: System delay and mortality among patients with STEMI treated with primary percutaneous coronary intervention

claims.claim_en: When a heart attack strikes, just lie down at home, take some medicine and tough it out — no need to go to hospital.
claims.claim_zh: 心梗发作时先在家躺一躺、吃点药忍一忍，缓过来就没事了，不用去医院。
claims.why_zh: 心梗时每耽误半小时，心肌就多坏死一块，死亡风险明显上升，必须马上打120去医院开通血管。

citations.key_finding: nine modifiable risk factors accounted for over 90% of the population-attributable risk of heart attack in both sexes and at all ages in all regions
citations.title: Effect of potentially modifiable risk factors associated with myocardial infarction in 52 countries (the INTERHEART study): case-control study

citations.key_finding: ten modifiable risk factors accounted for about 90.7% of stroke risk, including a population-attributable risk of 92.2% in patients aged 55 or younger
citations.title: Global and regional effects of potentially modifiable risk factors associated with acute stroke in 32 countries (INTERSTROKE): a case-control study

citations.key_finding: current smoking carried an odds ratio of 2.95 for non-fatal heart attack versus never smoking, with risk rising 5.6% per extra cigarette per day, across age groups
citations.title: Tobacco use and risk of myocardial infarction in 52 countries in the INTERHEART study: a case-control study

claims.claim_en: Heart attacks and strokes are diseases of old people; young people don't need to worry about them.
claims.claim_zh: 心梗和脑梗是老年人的病，年轻人不用担心。
claims.why_zh: 引起心梗脑梗的主要危险因素，比如吸烟、高血压、血脂异常，对年轻人一样起作用，而且九成以上的风险来自这些可以改变的因素。

citations.key_finding: omega-3 supplements had no significant association with coronary heart disease death, nonfatal heart attack, or major vascular events across 77,917 participants
citations.title: Associations of Omega-3 Fatty Acid Supplement Use With Cardiovascular Disease Risks: Meta-analysis of 10 Trials Involving 77 917 Individuals

citations.key_finding: in 15,480 people with diabetes, n-3 fatty acid supplements did not reduce serious vascular events (8.9% vs 9.2%; rate ratio 0.97)
citations.title: Effects of n-3 Fatty Acid Supplements in Diabetes Mellitus

citations.key_finding: in the VITAL trial of 25,871 adults, marine n-3 fatty acids did not significantly lower major cardiovascular events or invasive cancer versus placebo
citations.title: Marine n-3 Fatty Acids and Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease and Cancer

claims.claim_en: Taking deep-sea fish oil every day can prevent heart disease.
claims.claim_zh: 每天吃深海鱼油，就能预防心脏病。
claims.why_zh: 好几个上万人参加的大试验都发现，鱼油胶囊并没有减少心梗和中风；想护心还是要好好吃饭、多运动、控制三高。

citations.key_finding: long-term daily aspirin in secondary prevention cut serious vascular events from 8.2% to 6.7% per year — proven stroke prevention is sustained daily medication, not periodic infusions
citations.title: Aspirin in the primary and secondary prevention of vascular disease: collaborative meta-analysis of individual participant data from randomised trials

citations.key_finding: long-term blood-pressure lowering cut recurrent stroke by 28% overall and by 43% with perindopril plus indapamide in 6,105 patients
citations.title: Randomised trial of a perindopril-based blood-pressure-lowering regimen among 6,105 individuals with previous stroke or transient ischaemic attack

citations.key_finding: daily atorvastatin 80 mg after stroke or TIA reduced recurrent stroke (hazard ratio 0.84) and major cardiovascular events (0.80) over a median 4.9 years
citations.title: High-dose atorvastatin after stroke or transient ischemic attack

claims.claim_en: Getting an IV infusion twice a year can clear your blood vessels and prevent strokes.
claims.claim_zh: 每年去医院输两次液，就能疏通血管、预防脑梗。
claims.why_zh: 没有任何证据说输液能通血管；真正被证明能防脑梗的，是每天坚持吃降压、抗血小板和降血脂的药。

citations.key_finding: cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death in women, with an estimated 275 million women living with it in 2019, yet it remains understudied and undertreated in women
citations.title: The Lancet women and cardiovascular disease Commission: reducing the global burden by 2030

citations.key_finding: among 1,143,513 heart attack patients, women more often presented without chest pain (42.0% vs 30.7%) and had higher in-hospital mortality than men (14.6% vs 10.3%)
citations.title: Association of age and sex with myocardial infarction symptom presentation and in-hospital mortality

citations.key_finding: the AHA's first scientific statement on heart attack in women documents that cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of mortality in women, with sex differences in presentation, mechanisms and outcomes
citations.title: Acute Myocardial Infarction in Women: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association

claims.claim_en: Heart disease is a man's disease; women don't get heart attacks.
claims.claim_zh: 心脏病是男人的病，女人不会得心梗。
claims.why_zh: 心血管病其实是女性死亡的第一大原因，而且女性心梗常常没有胸痛，更容易被漏诊、被耽误。

citations.key_finding: moderate physical activity was associated with lower mortality (hazard ratio 0.80) and major cardiovascular disease (0.86) in 130,843 people across 17 countries
citations.title: The effect of physical activity on mortality and cardiovascular disease in 130 000 people from 17 high-income, middle-income, and low-income countries: the PURE study

citations.key_finding: in over 1 million people, the most active group (about 60-75 minutes of moderate activity daily) had no excess mortality from prolonged sitting
citations.title: Does physical activity attenuate, or even eliminate, the detrimental association of sitting time with mortality? A harmonised meta-analysis of data from more than 1 million men and women

citations.key_finding: meeting the recommended activity minimum was associated with 31% lower mortality, and even activity below the minimum gave a 20% lower risk, in 661,137 people
citations.title: Leisure Time Physical Activity and Mortality: A Detailed Pooled Analysis of the Dose-Response Relationship

claims.claim_en: Moderate-intensity exercise like brisk walking every day really does lower the risk of cardiovascular disease.
claims.claim_zh: 每天快走等中等强度的运动，真的能降低心脑血管病的风险。
claims.why_zh: 十几万人的长期跟踪发现，动得越多的人死于心脑血管病的越少，就算只达到推荐的最低运动量也有明显好处。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: double-blind crossover trial: high-sugar diets did not change children's behavior or cognition on any of 39 measures
citations.title: Effects of diets high in sucrose or aspartame on the behavior and cognitive performance of children

citations.key_finding: meta-analysis of 23 controlled studies: sugar did not affect children's behavior or cognitive performance
citations.title: The effect of sugar on behavior or cognition in children. A meta-analysis

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: NEJM editorial on the trial evidence: sugar does not induce hyperactivity in children
citations.title: Sugar and the hyperactive child

claims.claim_en: Eating too much sugar makes children hyperactive
claims.claim_zh: 孩子吃糖多了会变多动、坐不住
claims.why_zh: 科学家把孩子分成吃真糖和吃代糖两组偷偷观察，吃真糖的孩子一点也没更闹腾，觉得孩子变闹多半是大人先入为主的错觉。

citations.key_finding: IARC classified processed meat as Group 1 (carcinogenic); each 50 g/day portion raises colorectal cancer risk by about 18%
citations.title: Carcinogenicity of consumption of red and processed meat

citations.key_finding: increasing processed red meat intake was associated with higher total mortality (HR 1.13 per additional half serving/day)
citations.title: Association of changes in red meat consumption with total and cause specific mortality among US women and men: two prospective cohort studies

citations.key_finding: high processed meat intake was associated with about 8.2% of cardiometabolic deaths in the United States
citations.title: Association Between Dietary Factors and Mortality From Heart Disease, Stroke, and Type 2 Diabetes in the United States

claims.claim_en: Eating a lot of processed meat such as ham sausage, bacon and sausages causes cancer
claims.claim_zh: 火腿肠、培根、香肠这类加工肉吃多了会致癌
claims.why_zh: 世卫组织把加工肉列为明确致癌物，每天多吃大约一两，肠癌风险就明显上升。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in 641 children over 18 months, the sugar-sweetened beverage group gained about 1 kg more than the sugar-free group
citations.title: A trial of sugar-free or sugar-sweetened beverages and body weight in children

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: replacing sugary drinks reduced BMI gain in overweight adolescents at one year
citations.title: A randomized trial of sugar-sweetened beverages and adolescent body weight

citations.key_finding: two or more sugary drinks per day were associated with 21% higher total mortality and 31% higher cardiovascular mortality
citations.title: Long-Term Consumption of Sugar-Sweetened and Artificially Sweetened Beverages and Risk of Mortality in US Adults

claims.claim_en: Drinking sugary drinks like cola and milk tea regularly makes you gain weight and raises the risk of early death
claims.claim_zh: 常喝可乐、奶茶等含糖饮料会让人发胖，还会增加早死风险
claims.why_zh: 液体糖不顶饱，热量很容易不知不觉喝超标，实验里喝含糖饮料的孩子一年就比喝无糖饮料的孩子多长了约一公斤。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: low sodium combined with the DASH diet lowered systolic blood pressure by 11.5 mmHg in hypertensive participants versus the high-sodium control diet
citations.title: Effects on blood pressure of reduced dietary sodium and the Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) diet

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in 20,995 people in rural China, potassium-enriched salt substitute lowered stroke (RR 0.86), major cardiovascular events and death
citations.title: Effect of Salt Substitution on Cardiovascular Events and Death

citations.key_finding: higher salt intake was associated with a 23% higher risk of stroke in prospective studies
citations.title: Salt intake, stroke, and cardiovascular disease: meta-analysis of prospective studies

claims.claim_en: Eating too much salt raises blood pressure and increases the risk of stroke
claims.claim_zh: 盐吃多了会升高血压，还会增加中风风险
claims.why_zh: 盐里的钠会让血管压力变大，少吃盐血压真的会降，中国农村两万多人的大实验还证明换低钠盐能减少中风和死亡。

citations.key_finding: consumption of up to one egg per day was not associated with increased cardiovascular disease risk
citations.title: Egg consumption and risk of cardiovascular disease: three large prospective US cohort studies, systematic review, and updated meta-analysis

citations.key_finding: higher dietary cholesterol and egg intake were associated with higher cardiovascular disease and mortality risk in a dose-response manner
citations.title: Associations of Dietary Cholesterol or Egg Consumption With Incident Cardiovascular Disease and Mortality

citations.key_finding: AHA advisory: dietary cholesterol within a healthy dietary pattern is not a major risk driver, but very high intakes should be limited
citations.title: Dietary Cholesterol and Cardiovascular Risk: A Science Advisory From the American Heart Association

claims.claim_en: Egg yolks are so high in cholesterol that they clog blood vessels, so you should eat at most one egg a day
claims.claim_zh: 鸡蛋黄胆固醇太高会堵血管，一天最多吃一个鸡蛋
claims.why_zh: 对大多数健康人来说每天吃一个鸡蛋并不会增加心脏病风险，但膳食胆固醇总量吃得特别多确实可能有害，问题在总量而不是鸡蛋本身。

citations.key_finding: IARC reclassified coffee as Group 3 (not classifiable as carcinogenic); only very hot beverages above 65°C were classified Group 2A
citations.title: Carcinogenicity of drinking coffee, mate, and very hot beverages

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in about 400,000 adults, coffee drinking was inversely associated with total mortality, with no association with cancer death
citations.title: Association of coffee drinking with total and cause-specific mortality

citations.key_finding: umbrella review: coffee consumption at 3-4 cups per day was associated with lower, not higher, incidence of several cancers
citations.title: Coffee consumption and health: umbrella review of meta-analyses of multiple health outcomes

claims.claim_en: Drinking coffee causes cancer
claims.claim_zh: 喝咖啡会致癌
claims.why_zh: 世卫组织审查了上千项研究后把咖啡移出了可疑致癌名单，大样本人群里喝咖啡的人死亡率反而更低，真正要小心的是超过65度的烫饮。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: 12-month RCT in 139 adults with obesity: time-restricted eating plus calorie restriction lost no more weight than calorie restriction alone (-8.0 vs -6.3 kg, not significant)
citations.title: Calorie Restriction with or without Time-Restricted Eating in Weight Loss

citations.key_finding: a 16:8 eating window produced no significant weight loss versus three meals a day (between-group difference -0.26 kg)
citations.title: Effects of Time-Restricted Eating on Weight Loss and Other Metabolic Parameters in Women and Men With Overweight and Obesity: The TREAT Randomized Clinical Trial

citations.key_finding: alternate-day fasting was not superior to ordinary daily calorie restriction for weight loss
citations.title: Effect of Alternate-Day Fasting on Weight Loss, Weight Maintenance, and Cardioprotection Among Metabolically Healthy Obese Adults: A Randomized Clinical Trial

claims.claim_en: 16:8 intermittent fasting is far more effective for weight loss than simply eating less
claims.claim_zh: 16:8间歇性禁食比普通少吃减肥效果强得多
claims.why_zh: 禁食确实能帮一些人自然少吃，但和同样控制热量的普通节食比，减重效果差不多，它赢在容易坚持，而不是有什么魔法。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: PREDIMED: a Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil or nuts cut major cardiovascular events by about 30% (HR 0.69 and 0.72)
citations.title: Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease with a Mediterranean Diet Supplemented with Extra-Virgin Olive Oil or Nuts

citations.key_finding: after a first heart attack, a Mediterranean-style diet reduced cardiac death and nonfatal myocardial infarction (adjusted risk ratios 0.28-0.53)
citations.title: Mediterranean diet, traditional risk factors, and the rate of cardiovascular complications after myocardial infarction: final report of the Lyon Diet Heart Study

citations.key_finding: in 1,002 patients with coronary disease, a Mediterranean diet beat a low-fat diet for preventing new cardiovascular events (87 vs 111 events)
citations.title: Long-term secondary prevention of cardiovascular disease with a Mediterranean diet and a low-fat diet (CORDIOPREV): a randomised controlled trial

claims.claim_en: A Mediterranean diet (lots of vegetables, olive oil, fish and nuts) prevents cardiovascular disease
claims.claim_zh: 地中海饮食（多吃蔬菜、橄榄油、鱼和坚果）能预防心脑血管病
claims.why_zh: 七千多人的大型随机实验发现，坚持地中海饮食并加橄榄油或坚果的人，心梗、中风等心血管大事减少了约三成。

citations.key_finding: each 10% higher share of ultra-processed food in the diet was associated with about 12% higher cardiovascular disease risk
citations.title: Ultra-processed food intake and risk of cardiovascular disease: prospective cohort study (NutriNet-Santé)

citations.key_finding: highest versus lowest quarter of ultra-processed food consumption had 62% higher all-cause mortality (HR 1.62)
citations.title: Association between consumption of ultra-processed foods and all cause mortality: SUN prospective cohort study

citations.key_finding: each 10% increase in ultra-processed food share was associated with 14% higher mortality in 44,551 adults
citations.title: Association Between Ultraprocessed Food Consumption and Risk of Mortality Among Middle-aged Adults in France

claims.claim_en: Eating a lot of ultra-processed food (chips, instant noodles, processed snacks) increases the risk of death and cardiovascular disease
claims.claim_zh: 超加工食品（薯片、方便面、加工零食）吃多了会增加死亡和心血管病风险
claims.why_zh: 法国十万人的追踪研究发现，超加工食品在每天饮食里占比每多一成，心血管病风险就上升一成多，死亡风险也跟着涨。

citations.key_finding: global burden analysis: the level of alcohol consumption that minimises health loss is zero
citations.title: Alcohol use and burden for 195 countries and territories, 1990-2016: a systematic analysis for the Global Burden of Disease Study 2016

citations.key_finding: meta-analysis of 107 cohorts: after adjusting for study biases, low-volume drinking gave no significant protection against mortality
citations.title: Association Between Daily Alcohol Intake and Risk of All-Cause Mortality: A Systematic Review and Meta-analyses

citations.key_finding: lowest mortality risk was at or below 100 g of alcohol per week, and stroke and heart failure risk rose steadily with intake
citations.title: Risk thresholds for alcohol consumption: combined analysis of individual-participant data for 599 912 current drinkers in 83 prospective studies

claims.claim_en: A moderate daily glass of red wine is good for your heart
claims.claim_zh: 每天适量喝点红酒对心脏有好处
claims.why_zh: 以前说少量喝酒的人更长寿，其实是因为不喝酒的人里混着很多因病戒酒的人；把这种偏差去掉后，对健康最安全的酒精量是零。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: VITAL trial (n=25,871): vitamin D did not reduce invasive cancer (HR 0.96) or major cardiovascular events (HR 0.97)
citations.title: Vitamin D Supplements and Prevention of Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: VITAL fracture analysis: supplemental vitamin D did not reduce total, hip, or nonvertebral fractures (HR 0.98)
citations.title: Supplemental Vitamin D and Incident Fractures in Midlife and Older Adults

citations.key_finding: across 81 randomised trials, vitamin D supplementation had no effect on fractures, falls, or bone mineral density

claims.claim_en: Everyone should take vitamin D supplements to prevent fractures and cancer
claims.claim_zh: 人人都应该补维生素D，能防骨折、防癌
claims.why_zh: 两万多人的大实验发现，本身不缺维生素D的普通人补了它，骨折和癌症一点也没减少，真正缺乏的人才需要补。

claims.claim_en: Taking fish oil capsules prevents heart disease
claims.claim_zh: 吃鱼油胶囊能预防心脏病
claims.why_zh: 好几万人参加的大型实验都发现，普通鱼油胶囊对预防心梗、中风和心血管死亡基本没用，吃鱼本身不等于吃胶囊。

citations.title: Vitamin, Mineral, and Multivitamin Supplementation to Prevent Cardiovascular Disease and Cancer: US Preventive Services Task Force Recommendation Statement

claims.claim_en: Taking one multivitamin a day prevents disease and cancer
claims.claim_zh: 每天吃一颗复合维生素就能防病防癌
claims.why_zh: 一万多名医生参加的实验发现，复合维生素防不了心血管病，对癌症最多只有一点点作用，美国官方结论是证据不足、不推荐靠它来防病。

claims.claim_en: Taking antioxidant supplements such as beta carotene prevents cancer and prolongs life
claims.claim_zh: 补β-胡萝卜素等抗氧化维生素能防癌、延寿
claims.why_zh: 恰恰相反，给吸烟者补β-胡萝卜素的大实验发现肺癌反而变多了，有的实验还因为害处明显被提前叫停。

citations.title: Ginkgo biloba for prevention of dementia: a randomized controlled trial

citations.key_finding: ginkgo biloba did not slow the rate of decline in memory or any other cognitive domain
citations.title: Ginkgo biloba for preventing cognitive decline in older adults: a randomized trial

claims.claim_en: Ginkgo biloba extract improves memory and prevents dementia
claims.claim_zh: 吃银杏叶提取物能提高记忆力、预防老年痴呆
claims.why_zh: 美国和法国各有几千名老人吃了好几年银杏叶提取物，痴呆该发生的还是发生，和吃安慰剂没有区别。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

citations.title: Glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate, and the two in combination for painful knee osteoarthritis

citations.title: Effects of glucosamine, chondroitin, or placebo in patients with osteoarthritis of hip or knee: network meta-analysis

citations.key_finding: the apparent benefit of glucosamine disappeared in trials with adequate allocation concealment
citations.title: Glucosamine therapy for treating osteoarthritis

claims.claim_en: Glucosamine and chondroitin repair cartilage and cure arthritis
claims.claim_zh: 葡萄糖胺和软骨素能修复软骨、治好关节炎
claims.why_zh: 一千五百多人的大实验和汇总分析都显示，它们的止痛效果和安慰剂差不多，也没能让变窄的关节缝隙变宽。

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine

citations.title: Lactobacillus rhamnosus GG versus Placebo for Acute Gastroenteritis in Children

citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: in 886 children, a combination Lactobacillus probiotic did not prevent moderate-to-severe gastroenteritis
citations.title: Multicenter Trial of a Combination Probiotic for Children with Gastroenteritis

citations.key_finding: across 82 trials, probiotics probably make little or no difference to diarrhoea lasting 48 hours or longer
citations.title: Probiotics for treating acute infectious diarrhoea

claims.claim_en: Probiotics make children's diarrhoea go away faster
claims.claim_zh: 孩子拉肚子吃益生菌就能好得快
claims.why_zh: 美国和加拿大两个各近千名儿童的大实验都发现，吃益生菌和吃安慰剂的孩子好得一样快。

citations.key_finding: vitamin E 400 IU/day increased prostate cancer risk by 17% (HR 1.17) in the SELECT trial
citations.title: Vitamin E and the risk of prostate cancer: the Selenium and Vitamin E Cancer Prevention Trial (SELECT)

citations.key_finding: HOPE and HOPE-TOO: long-term vitamin E did not reduce cancer or major cardiovascular events and increased heart failure risk (RR 1.13)
citations.title: Effects of long-term vitamin E supplementation on cardiovascular events and cancer: a randomized controlled trial

citations.key_finding: in 39,876 women, vitamin E provided no overall benefit for the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease or cancer
citations.title: Vitamin E in the primary prevention of cardiovascular disease and cancer: the Women's Health Study: a randomized controlled trial

claims.claim_en: Vitamin E prevents cancer and slows ageing
claims.claim_zh: 维生素E能防癌、抗衰老
claims.why_zh: 三万多人的实验发现，每天补维生素E的男性前列腺癌反而多了17%，对心血管病也没有保护作用。

citations.key_finding: DOMInO trial (n=2,399): prenatal DHA supplementation did not improve children's cognitive scores at 18 months (adjusted mean difference 0.01)
citations.title: Effect of DHA supplementation during pregnancy on maternal depression and neurodevelopment of young children: a randomized controlled trial

citations.key_finding: at age 4, children of DHA-supplemented mothers scored no better on cognition, language, or executive function (adjusted mean difference 0.29, P=.73)
citations.title: Four-year follow-up of children born to women in a randomized trial of prenatal DHA supplementation

citations.key_finding: 70 RCTs: omega-3 in pregnancy reduced preterm birth, but no clear benefit for children's cognitive development was shown
citations.title: Omega-3 fatty acid addition during pregnancy

claims.claim_en: Taking DHA during pregnancy makes the baby smarter
claims.claim_zh: 孕妇补DHA能让宝宝更聪明
claims.why_zh: 两千多名孕妇参加的实验一路追踪到孩子4岁，补DHA的孩子在智力、语言等测试上和没补的孩子没有差别。

citations.key_finding: 33 randomised trials (51,145 participants): calcium, vitamin D, or both were not associated with lower hip or other fracture risk
citations.title: Association Between Calcium or Vitamin D Supplementation and Fracture Incidence in Community-Dwelling Older Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis

citations.key_finding: USPSTF recommends against daily low-dose vitamin D plus calcium for primary fracture prevention in community-dwelling postmenopausal women
citations.title: Vitamin D, Calcium, or Combined Supplementation for the Primary Prevention of Fractures in Community-Dwelling Adults: US Preventive Services Task Force Recommendation Statement

citations.title: Oral vitamin D3 and calcium for secondary prevention of low-trauma fractures in elderly people (Randomised Evaluation of Calcium Or vitamin D, RECORD): a randomised placebo-controlled trial

claims.claim_en: All middle-aged and older adults should take calcium plus vitamin D to prevent fractures
claims.claim_zh: 中老年人都应该吃钙片加维生素D来预防骨折
claims.why_zh: 汇总五万多人的实验数据发现，能自理生活的老人常规补钙和维生素D并不能减少骨折，美国官方也不推荐这样做来防骨折。

claims.claim_zh: 枕头高低会影响肩颈健康，选对枕头就能睡个好觉。
claims.claim_en: Pillow height affects neck and shoulder health, and picking the right pillow guarantees a good night's sleep.
claims.why_zh: 枕头太高或太低都会让脖子整晚弯着、容易酸痛，但适合每个人的高度不一样，没有一种神奇枕头适合所有人。

citations.title: The effects of pillow designs on neck pain, waking symptoms, neck disability, sleep quality and spinal alignment in adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis
citations.key_finding: Rubber and spring pillows reduced neck pain and disability, but pillow design did not change sleep quality; alignment depended on shape and height.

citations.title: Improving the quality of sleep with an optimal pillow: a randomized, comparative study
citations.journal: The Tohoku Journal of Experimental Medicine
citations.key_finding: An individually fitted orthopedic pillow improved sleep quality compared with standard pillows in a randomized comparison.

citations.title: Changes in neck pain and somatic symptoms before and after the adjustment of the pillow height
citations.key_finding: Precisely adjusted pillow height reduced neck pain and somatic symptoms, with about half of patients reaching a clinically important improvement.

claims.claim_zh: 睡硬板床能保护腰椎，腰不好就该睡硬床。
claims.claim_en: Sleeping on a hard board protects the spine, and people with back problems should sleep on a firm bed.
claims.why_zh: 大型试验发现中等软硬的床垫对腰最好，睡太硬的床反而会让腰更痛。

citations.title: Effect of firmness of mattress on chronic non-specific low-back pain: randomised, double-blind, controlled, multicentre trial
citations.key_finding: Medium-firm mattresses beat firm mattresses for chronic non-specific low-back pain in a randomized double-blind trial.

citations.title: Effect of different mattress designs on promoting sleep quality, pain reduction, and spinal alignment in adults with or without back pain; systematic review of controlled trials
citations.key_finding: Medium-firm and custom-inflated mattresses were optimal for sleep quality, pain reduction and spinal alignment.

citations.title: What type of mattress should be chosen to avoid back pain and improve sleep quality? Review of the literature
citations.key_finding: Medium-firm mattresses best support spinal alignment and sleep quality; overly hard surfaces are not recommended.

claims.claim_zh: 睡前喝一杯酒能助眠，睡得更香。
claims.claim_en: A drink before bed helps you fall asleep and sleep more soundly.
claims.why_zh: 酒只能让你更快睡着，后半夜反而睡得更碎、更容易醒，长期靠它助眠会越睡越差。

citations.title: The effect of alcohol on subsequent sleep in healthy adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis
citations.key_finding: Alcohol disrupted REM sleep from about two standard drinks upward, with a clear dose-response relationship.

citations.title: Alcohol and sleep I: effects on normal sleep
citations.key_finding: Alcohol consolidated sleep in the first half of the night but disrupted the second half at all doses.

citations.title: Altered sleep architecture following consecutive nights of presleep alcohol
citations.key_finding: Three consecutive nights of pre-sleep alcohol measurably reduced REM sleep in a crossover laboratory study.

claims.claim_zh: 人每天必须睡够8小时，少一点都不行。
claims.claim_en: Everyone must sleep exactly 8 hours a day; any less is not enough.
claims.why_zh: 大多数成年人睡7到9小时就够了，不必死守8小时，而且睡得过久同样和健康问题有关。

citations.title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for a Healthy Adult: A Joint Consensus Statement of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and Sleep Research Society
citations.key_finding: The expert consensus recommends 7 or more hours of sleep for healthy adults, not exactly 8.

citations.title: Sleep duration and all-cause mortality: a systematic review and meta-analysis of prospective studies
citations.key_finding: Both short sleep (RR 1.12) and long sleep (RR 1.30) were associated with higher mortality, a U-shaped relationship.

citations.title: National Sleep Foundation's sleep time duration recommendations: methodology and results summary
citations.key_finding: Recommended sleep is a range: 7-9 hours for adults and 7-8 hours for older adults, not a fixed 8 hours.

claims.claim_zh: 平时熬夜没关系，周末睡个懒觉就能把觉补回来。
claims.claim_en: Staying up late on weekdays is fine because sleeping in on weekends fully pays back the sleep debt.
claims.why_zh: 实验发现周末狂睡补不回平时欠的觉，身体的代谢和注意力还是会变差。

citations.title: Ad libitum Weekend Recovery Sleep Fails to Prevent Metabolic Dysregulation during a Repeating Pattern of Insufficient Sleep and Weekend Recovery Sleep
citations.key_finding: Weekend recovery sleep failed to prevent metabolic harm; insulin sensitivity still fell by 9-27%.

citations.title: Neurobehavioral dynamics following chronic sleep restriction: dose-response effects of one night for recovery
citations.key_finding: Even a 10-hour recovery night did not fully restore alertness after chronic sleep restriction.

citations.title: The cumulative cost of additional wakefulness: dose-response effects on neurobehavioral functions and sleep physiology from chronic sleep restriction and total sleep deprivation
citations.key_finding: Cognitive deficits accumulated day by day under chronic sleep restriction, showing sleep debt is not erased by one good night.

claims.claim_zh: 打呼噜是睡得香、睡得沉的表现。
claims.claim_en: Snoring is a sign of sleeping soundly and deeply.
claims.why_zh: 严重的打呼噜常常是呼吸在睡眠中反复停掉，会让心脏和大脑缺氧，是病不是睡得香。

citations.title: Long-term cardiovascular outcomes in men with obstructive sleep apnoea-hypopnoea with or without treatment with continuous positive airway pressure: an observational study
citations.key_finding: Untreated severe obstructive sleep apnoea significantly increased fatal and non-fatal cardiovascular events.

citations.title: Prospective study of the association between sleep-disordered breathing and hypertension
citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: Sleep-disordered breathing predicted new-onset hypertension in a dose-response manner.

citations.title: Obstructive sleep apnea as a risk factor for stroke and death
citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: Obstructive sleep apnoea nearly doubled the risk of stroke or death (adjusted HR 1.97).

claims.claim_zh: 经常睡不够真的会让人变胖。
claims.claim_en: Regularly sleeping too little really does make people gain weight.
claims.why_zh: 睡不够会让人更饿、更想吃高热量食物，好几项大研究都发现睡得少的人更容易胖。

citations.title: Meta-analysis of short sleep duration and obesity in children and adults
citations.key_finding: Short sleep was consistently associated with obesity (OR 1.55 in adults, 1.89 in children).

citations.title: Sleep Duration and Quality: Impact on Lifestyle Behaviors and Cardiometabolic Health: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association
citations.key_finding: The American Heart Association statement links short sleep duration to obesity and cardiometabolic risk.

citations.title: Effects of Experimental Sleep Restriction on Weight Gain, Caloric Intake, and Meal Timing in Healthy Adults
citations.key_finding: Sleep-restricted adults gained 0.97 kg versus 0.11 kg in controls, driven by about 553 extra late-night calories.

claims.claim_zh: 午睡越久越补，睡一下午都没关系。
claims.claim_en: The longer the nap, the better; napping all afternoon does no harm.
claims.why_zh: 午睡小睡一会儿最好，经常睡超过1小时反而和心脏病风险升高有关，还容易越睡越晕。

citations.title: Daytime Napping and the Risk of Cardiovascular Disease and All-Cause Mortality: A Prospective Study and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis
citations.key_finding: Naps of 60 minutes or longer were linked to higher cardiovascular disease (RR 1.82) and mortality (RR 1.27); shorter naps were not.

citations.title: Association of napping with incident cardiovascular events in a prospective cohort study
citations.key_finding: Napping once or twice a week was associated with fewer cardiovascular events (HR 0.52), while daily napping showed no benefit.

citations.title: A brief afternoon nap following nocturnal sleep restriction: which nap duration is most recuperative?
citations.key_finding: A 10-minute nap was the most restorative; a 30-minute nap first produced sleep inertia and impaired performance.

claims.claim_zh: 褪黑素是安眠神药，没副作用，多吃点也没事。
claims.claim_en: Melatonin is a miracle sleep drug with no side effects, so taking extra is harmless.
claims.why_zh: 研究发现褪黑素对多数失眠帮助很小，而且市面上很多产品实际含量和标签写的完全不一样。

citations.title: Efficacy and safety of exogenous melatonin for secondary sleep disorders and sleep disorders accompanying sleep restriction: meta-analysis
citations.key_finding: The meta-analysis found no evidence that melatonin is effective for these sleep disorders, with safety shown only for short-term use.

citations.title: Quantity of Melatonin and CBD in Melatonin Gummies Sold in the US
citations.key_finding: 22 of 25 melatonin gummy products were mislabeled, containing 74% to 347% of the declared melatonin amount.

citations.title: Melatonin Natural Health Products and Supplements: Presence of Serotonin and Significant Variability of Melatonin Content
citations.key_finding: Actual melatonin content ranged from -83% to +478% of the label claim, and 26% of products also contained serotonin.

claims.claim_zh: 安眠药很安全，失眠的人长期天天吃也没依赖、没风险。
claims.claim_en: Sleeping pills are perfectly safe; people with insomnia can take them every day long-term with no dependence or risk.
claims.why_zh: 大型研究发现长期吃安眠药和更高的副作用、死亡风险有关，受害的人比真正受益的人还多。

citations.title: Effect of anxiolytic and hypnotic drug prescriptions on mortality hazards: retrospective cohort study
citations.key_finding: Hypnotic prescriptions were associated with increased mortality in a dose-response pattern (adjusted HR up to 3.32).

citations.title: Sedative hypnotics in older people with insomnia: meta-analysis of risks and benefits
citations.key_finding: In older adults, the number needed to harm (6) was smaller than the number needed to treat for better sleep (13).

citations.title: Effectiveness of non-benzodiazepine hypnotics in treatment of adult insomnia: meta-analysis of data submitted to the Food and Drug Administration
citations.key_finding: Z-drugs shortened time to fall asleep by only about 22 minutes versus placebo, and much of the response was a placebo effect.

claims.claim_zh: 16+8轻断食不用控制热量，光靠空腹时间长就能瘦。
claims.claim_en: With 16:8 intermittent fasting you don't need to watch calories; the long fasting window alone makes you lose weight.
claims.why_zh: 好几个严格实验发现，只改吃饭时间不管总量，瘦下来的效果和普通节食没差别。

citations.title: Calorie Restriction with or without Time-Restricted Eating in Weight Loss
citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: Adding an 8-hour eating window to calorie restriction gave no significant extra weight loss over 12 months (-8.0 vs -6.3 kg).

citations.title: Effects of Time-Restricted Eating on Weight Loss and Other Metabolic Parameters in Women and Men With Overweight and Obesity: The TREAT Randomized Clinical Trial
citations.key_finding: 16:8 eating with no calorie targets lost no more weight than three regular meals (-0.94 vs -0.68 kg).

citations.title: Effect of Alternate-Day Fasting on Weight Loss, Weight Maintenance, and Cardioprotection Among Metabolically Healthy Obese Adults: A Randomized Clinical Trial
citations.key_finding: Alternate-day fasting matched daily calorie restriction (-6.0% vs -5.3%) and had the highest dropout rate.

claims.claim_zh: 膝盖一疼就说明不能运动了，应该静养少动。
claims.claim_en: Knee pain means you must stop exercising and rest as much as possible.
claims.why_zh: 试验发现膝盖疼的人坚持适度锻炼，疼痛反而减轻，很多人因此不用做换关节手术。

citations.title: Effects of intensive diet and exercise on knee joint loads, inflammation, and clinical outcomes among overweight and obese adults with knee osteoarthritis: the IDEA randomized clinical trial
citations.key_finding: Diet plus exercise improved pain, function and joint loads more than either intervention alone in knee osteoarthritis.

citations.title: Exercise for osteoarthritis of the knee: a Cochrane systematic review
citations.key_finding: Exercise reduced knee osteoarthritis pain by about 12 points on a 100-point scale, an effect comparable to anti-inflammatory drugs.

citations.title: A Randomized, Controlled Trial of Total Knee Replacement
citations.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
citations.key_finding: An exercise-based nonsurgical program improved pain and function, and 74% of that group avoided knee surgery within a year.

claims.claim_zh: 运动不满30分钟就不燃烧脂肪，不到半小时等于白练。
claims.claim_en: Exercise under 30 minutes doesn't burn fat; anything shorter than half an hour is wasted.
claims.why_zh: 新版运动指南已经取消了最少10分钟才算数的规定，动几分钟也比完全不动强。

citations.title: The Physical Activity Guidelines for Americans
citations.key_finding: The 2018 US guidelines removed the old 10-minute minimum bout requirement, so activity of any duration counts.

citations.title: Dose-response associations between accelerometry measured physical activity and sedentary time and all cause mortality: systematic review and harmonised meta-analysis
citations.key_finding: Physical activity of any intensity was associated with lower mortality, with the steepest gains at low activity levels.

citations.title: World Health Organization 2020 guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
citations.key_finding: WHO states that some physical activity is better than none and sets no minimum bout length.

claims.claim_zh: 瘦子身体好，不用运动也健康。
claims.claim_en: Thin people are healthy and don't need to exercise.
claims.why_zh: 上百万人的数据显示，不管胖瘦，不运动的人死亡风险都更高，瘦也要动。

citations.title: Does physical activity attenuate, or even eliminate, the detrimental association of sitting time with mortality? A harmonised meta-analysis of data from more than 1 million men and women
citations.key_finding: The least active quarter had the highest mortality (up to HR 1.59); high activity eliminated the extra risk of prolonged sitting (HR 1.04).

citations.title: The effect of physical activity on mortality and cardiovascular disease in 130 000 people from 17 high-income, middle-income, and low-income countries: the PURE study
citations.key_finding: Physical activity, including non-recreational activity, was associated with lower mortality and cardiovascular disease across 17 countries.

citations.title: Leisure time physical activity and mortality: a detailed pooled analysis of the dose-response relationship
citations.key_finding: Even activity below the recommended minimum was linked to 20% lower mortality (HR 0.80) in 661,137 adults.

claims.claim_zh: 今天运动量达标了，奶茶甜点随便吃也不会长胖。
claims.claim_en: If you hit today's exercise target, you can eat bubble tea and desserts freely without gaining weight.
claims.why_zh: 研究发现光靠运动一年也瘦不了几斤，身体还会自动省电，热量很容易就被吃回来。

citations.title: Exercise for overweight or obesity
citations.key_finding: Exercise alone produced only small weight losses, and combining it with diet added only about 1 kg.

citations.title: Constrained Total Energy Expenditure and Metabolic Adaptation to Physical Activity in Adult Humans
citations.key_finding: Total daily energy expenditure plateaus at high activity levels, showing the body compensates for exercise.

citations.title: Isolated Aerobic Exercise and Weight Loss: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
citations.key_finding: Aerobic exercise alone produced only about 1.6-1.7 kg of weight loss over 6-12 months.

claims.claim_zh: 年纪大了就该静养，运动多了反而伤身。
claims.claim_en: Older people should rest and take it easy; too much exercise at that age is harmful.
claims.why_zh: 针对老年人的大试验发现，坚持活动能明显减少走不动路和摔倒的风险，越不动反而老得越快。

citations.title: Effect of structured physical activity on prevention of major mobility disability in older adults: the LIFE study randomized clinical trial
citations.key_finding: Structured physical activity reduced major mobility disability in adults aged 70-89 (HR 0.82).

citations.title: Exercise for preventing falls in older people living in the community
citations.key_finding: Exercise reduced the rate of falls by 23% in community-dwelling older people.

citations.title: Progressive resistance strength training for improving physical function in older adults
citations.key_finding: Progressive resistance training produced large strength gains in older adults (SMD 0.84) and improved physical function.

claims.claim_zh: 每天必须走满一万步，少一步都不算健康。
claims.claim_en: You must walk a full 10,000 steps every day; anything less doesn't count as healthy.
